_comment: Full roster incl. Burp. Use with: CLAWD_PI_MCP_CONFIGS='["/workspace/mcp.full.example.json"]' pi-ctf (copy this file into /workspace first). Burp's MCP server runs INSIDE Burp Suite on your HOST (PortSwigger/mcp-server, default SSE http://127.0.0.1:9876/sse). For the sandbox to reach it you must (1) have Burp running with the MCP extension enabled, and (2) open that port from br-pi in firewall.sh (currently only 8080 is allowed).
